improved: Filesystem reads/image limits have one owner; mutations own shared alias coordination and atomic replacement.
Shell lifetime/output/cancellation are isolated from tool declarations and ambient MAF run adaptation.
Public facade, schemas, descriptions, default selection and framework binding stay intact.
tradeoffs: Five source files replace one; aggregate lines increase modestly for explicit ownership and constructors.
Public compatibility facade retains direct forwarding entry points; execution remains one call into its real owner.
dependencyChanges: No package, assembly or project reference changes; no new interfaces. Shell execution consumes explicit session environment data and does not query MAF.
testMovement: None: existing capability-specific tests and stable identities remain, with two added characterizations.
verification: Complete scope passes preserved comparison: 1,858 baseline identities, 1,869 candidate identities; 66 reports/136 cases; 13 semantic assertions. Known classified failures unchanged.
patternDecision: Continue capability ownership inside existing projects where actual responsibilities separate; require a concrete compilation/dependency reason for any new project. Do not apply file-size-only splits.
